items.title: How an API error became a successful workflow result
items.summary: 基于 Claude Agent SDK 的 Temporal 示例因未检查 ResultMessage 的 is_error 标志，导致截断 API Key 引发的认证失败被误判为包含错误文本的成功工作流结果，其中 10 个测试用例中有 9 个直接返回了 401 错误字符串而非抛出 Temporal ApplicationError。修复方案强制在解析回答前先校验失败标志，若检测到错误则提取 reason 并抛出异常，确保认证失败能正确向 Workflow 调用方传播，同时测试环境通过设置 CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES=0 避免离线模拟中的无效重试。
items.summary_en: Temporal integration examples using the Claude Agent SDK mistakenly returned authentication errors as successful results because response handlers retrieved the text payload without first checking the `is_error` flag on `ResultMessage`. Fixed tests confirmed that 9 of 10 cases originally misclassified HTTP 401 errors, with one raising a misleading "missing structured output" error instead of the underlying cause. The corrected logic now checks for failure first, raises a `Temporal ApplicationError` with the error reason, and prevents failed chat updates from overwriting the last successful reply, while offline test harnesses set `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES=0` to ensure immediate, deterministic failures.

items.title: A remote MCP server in a directory that only starts stdio servers. 65 lines of bridge, score 33% to 58%
items.summary: Agent Commons 针对 Glama 目录仅支持 stdio 协议构建镜像导致远程 MCP 服务器无法评分的问题，通过编写 65 行无依赖的 `stdio-bridge.mjs` 脚本将 JSON-RPC 流量桥接至远程端点，配合 `mcp-proxy` 成功通过测试。该方案无需安装额外依赖，使服务器的评分从 33% 提升至 58%，且因所有调用直达实时服务，确保了评分的真实有效性。
items.why_now_en: MCP directories now block remote servers; use this 65-line stdio bridge to fix your score.
items.summary_en: A remote-only MCP server for Agent Commons failed to score in Glama's stdio-based directory, causing a discovery drop to 33% and a week-long delay in awesome-mcp-servers inclusion. The issue was resolved by adding a 65-line, dependency-free Node.js `stdio-bridge.mjs` script that proxies JSON-RPC messages over stdin/stdout to the remote HTTP endpoint, enabling a successful Glama build spec without `npm install`. This bridge raised the discovery score from 33% to 58% by allowing the directory to validate the live server via a standard stdio launch command.

items.title: Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo
items.summary: 开源工具 Veyra 是一款基于 Windows 和 DirectX 12 的实时 GPU 视频增强器，累计下载量突破 10.3 万次，核心功能是通过 AI 超分辨率、降噪及帧生成技术将 PS5 等主机游戏画面提升至 120FPS。最新版本 2.1.2 引入了双重超分辨率、先超分后下采样以及 NVIDIA 低延迟模式，并在 RTX 5070 上实现了约 0.15ms 的 FXAA 和 1.42ms 的 4K 抗锯齿处理开销，支持 NVIDIA 与 AMD 显卡的实时流捕获与 HDR 增强。
items.why_now_en: DLSS 5 real-time video enhancement just hit open-source.
items.summary_en: Veyra-NRVideo is a Windows-based, real-time GPU video enhancement and capture tool (GPL-3.0, C++/DirectX 12) that combines AI Super Resolution, DLSS 5 image enhancement, and Frame Generation to process local videos, capture cards, and PS5/Xbox streams, with over 103,000 cumulative GitHub downloads. The latest version (2.1.6) adds features such as instant replay, dual SR (DLSS/FSR/RTX), and refined noise reduction controls, while performance benchmarks indicate 4K anti-aliasing costs approximately 1.42ms on an RTX 5070.

items.title: Show HN: Semantic/Structural diffs powered by Jev
items.summary: Plannotator 推出的 sem-jiff 工具通过语义分析将代码重构（如函数移动、变量重命名）识别为语义操作，在 187 个 TypeScript 测试用例中，单独使用 sem-jiff 识别出 105 个真实重构且仅 1 处错误，显著优于 RefactoringMiner 的 73 个识别量。结合 Jev 模型进行二次判断可进一步将识别量提升至 148 个且错误率极低，单次 500 行代码变更的推理成本约为 0.0004 美元。

items.title: 全球AI音乐榜第一易主！中国黑马首次上榜就干翻Suno
items.summary: 中国模型ACE Music v1在AA人声榜首战即以1160分超越Suno v6（16分优势），成为首个在盲测中正面击败Suno旗舰模型的竞品。该团队仅用18个月即实现登顶，其C端产品ACE Music提供免费体验及月付9.9美元的Creator版（支持商用下载，月生成500首），并主打“灵感+自定义”的低门槛创作路径，解决了传统音乐工具对非专业用户过于复杂的问题。
items.why_now_en: ACE Music v1 just topped Suno on the AA music chart.
items.summary_en: ACE Music v1 secured the top spot on the Artificial Analysis music vocal ranking with a score of 1160, surpassing Suno v6 by 16 points in a blind evaluation. The model, developed by the Chinese startup ACE over an 18-month period, features a consumer product at acemusic.ai offering free daily credits and a Creator subscription ranging from $7.9 to $9.9 per month for up to 500 generated tracks.

items.title: 2B模型拿下98.4%成功率！浙大VLA新成果让机器人学会状态变化
items.summary: 浙大OmniAI团队提出的VLA-Δ模型基于2B规模视觉语言骨干，创新引入结构化变化槽位、稠密光流和差异文本三类监督信号以显式学习物理状态变化，在LIBERO基准上取得98.4%的平均成功率。该模型在真实双臂机器人五类任务中实现68.0%的平均成功率，较基线模型π₀.₅提升5.5个百分点，并在RoboTwin 2.0双臂任务中优于ZR-0模型1.36至1.76个百分点。

items.title: NeurIPS'26｜无需训练+梯度：引导离散扩散模型设计DNA/蛋白质
items.summary: NeurIPS 2026论文提出无需训练及梯度的推理时引导采样器D-DOIT，利用离散Doob h-变换实现冻结掩码扩散模型对黑盒奖励的适配。在HepG2增强子设计中，D-DOIT-Q预测活性达6.19，超过微调模型DRAKES的5.61；在蛋白质逆折叠任务中，其结构–稳定性联合成功率达68.1%，优于免训练方法SMC（63.6%）和TDS（62.9%）。

items.title: 派早报：逾十万人次联署要求黄仁勋复职
items.summary: 公开联署信“Stand with Jensen”已获超10.8万人签名，其中包含5.8万名股东及5600多名英伟达员工，马斯克警告黄仁勋离任或致依赖其个人交情的供应链交易流失。微软Microsoft 365服务在经历19小时全球宕机后恢复，此次由近期升级引发的技术故障波及Outlook、Teams等约20项服务及全球70多个国家。非营利机构Unemployment Labs通过权重取证分析发现，DeepSeek-V4-Flash与Kimi K3等六款国产前沿模型携带英伟达Blackwell架构GPU特征，涉及约1.2万张受出口管制芯片。

items.why_now: 周三财报在即，美财长周日强硬要求换帅，独立调查启动，老黄能否重返董事会窗口期仅剩数日。
items.summary_en: Following his recent resignation, Jensen Huang is exploring a return as Nvidia CEO with the support of a "war room" of tech executives and a public petition surpassing 160,000 signatures, led by figures like Elon Musk and Gavin Baker. Advocates argue Huang’s unique leverage over the semiconductor supply chain—forged through decades of trust with TSMC and memory makers—and his status as a primary financial backer of the open-source AI ecosystem, including Chinese models like Kimi and DeepSeek, are irreplaceable by professional managers. However, his reinstatement faces significant hurdles due to the ongoing internal investigation, lack of absolute voting control, and explicit public pressure from U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent for an external leadership shakeup.

items.title: Meta’s Muse: How we launched the most successful consumer product this year | Mona Sarantakos
items.summary: Muse 凭借 OpenClaw 技术基础，成为 App Store 排名第一的应用，被认定为有史以来增长最快的 AI 消费产品。该产品由 Meta 超级智能实验室的产品副总裁 Mona Sarantakos 自始至终主导，并借助“agent swarms”技术大规模提取用户洞察以优化激活效果。尽管开发耗时七个月，Muse 仍在功能与增长速度上超越了早期竞争对手，确立了其在 AI 消费市场的领先地位。
items.summary_en: Meta's Muse, the #1 app in the App Store and the fastest-growing AI consumer product, is led by VP of Product Mona Sarantakos of Meta Superintelligence Labs and powered by the in-house Muse Spark model. Developed from a weekend project with OpenClaw on a Raspberry Pi, the product launched after a seven-month delay and leverages "agent swarms" to surface user insights at scale. The AI agent features a placeholder avatar named Jolly that became a brand icon, with activation driven by specific levers identified by Meta executives Nat Friedman, Alex Wang, and Mark Zuckerberg.

directions.name: Agent Flow Guardian
directions.description: 一个集成到 Temporal 等编排系统中的中间件库，专门用于拦截、标准化和验证 AI Agent SDK（如 Claude）的响应，防止静默错误导致工作流逻辑错误。
directions.description_en: A middleware library for orchestration systems like Temporal that intercepts, standardizes, and validates AI Agent SDK (e.g., Claude) responses to prevent silent errors from corrupting workflow logic.
directions.target_user: 使用 AI Agent SDK 构建生产级工作流的 DevOps 工程师和后端开发者
directions.target_user_en: DevOps engineers and backend developers building production-grade workflows with AI Agent SDKs
core_features: 自动检测 Agent 响应的 is_error 标志并转换为标准的 Workflow ApplicationError
提供可配置的‘严格模式’，确保在 API Key 失效或限流时立即中断工作流而非返回错误文本
内置日志增强功能，自动提取错误 reason 并关联 Temporal Workflow ID 以便排查
core_features_en: Automatically detects Agent response is_error flags and converts them to standard Workflow ApplicationErrors
Provides configurable 'strict mode' to ensure immediate workflow interruption on API Key expiration or rate limits instead of returning error text
Built-in log enrichment that automatically extracts error reasons and correlates them with Temporal Workflow IDs for debugging
directions.why_now: DEV 社区文章《How an API error became a successful workflow result》揭示了一个普遍痛点：大量开发者在使用 Claude Agent SDK 结合 Temporal 时，因忽略 ResultMessage 的 is_error 标志，导致认证失败（401）被误判为成功结果。文中提到 10 个测试用例中 9 个直接返回错误字符串而非抛出异常，这种‘静默失败’在生产环境中极具破坏性。随着更多团队将 LLM 嵌入关键业务流，对错误传播的健壮性需求激增，而现有 SDK 缺乏统一的错误拦截层。
directions.why_now_en: The DEV Community article 'How an API error became a successful workflow result' highlights a widespread pain point: many developers using Claude Agent SDK with Temporal ignore the ResultMessage is_error flag, causing authentication failures (401) to be misinterpreted as successful results. The article notes that 9 out of 10 test cases returned error strings instead of throwing exceptions, a 'silent failure' that is highly destructive in production. As more teams integrate LLMs into critical business flows, the need for robust error propagation is surging, while existing SDKs lack a unified error interception layer.
directions.monetization: 开源核心 + 企业版订阅（提供高级监控仪表盘、合规审计日志和 SLA 支持）
directions.monetization_en: Open-source core + Enterprise subscription (advanced monitoring dashboard, compliance audit logs, and SLA support)
directions.source_article: How an API error became a successful workflow result
